name: Eastcompeace Technology Co.Ltd
summary: Eastcompeace Technology Co.Ltd is involved in the research and development, production, sales, and service of smart card and digital identity security products, and industry applications in China and internationally. The company also offers security modules, platform software, and smart terminals. It serves financial institutions, communication operators, government agencies, and IoT device manufacturers and operators. The company was formerly known as Eastcompeace Smart Card Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Eastcompeace Technology Co.Ltd in April 2012. Eastcompeace Technology Co.Ltd was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Zhuhai, China.
